caption: Without the plugin, a relative size in the link does nothing, and each image fills the column.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); await app.plugins.disablePlugin('relative-image-width'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active img[data-riw]').length; if (n) throw new Error('still sized '+n); return 'off'; })()
after: (async () => { await app.plugins.enablePlugin('relative-image-width'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: With the plugin, Live Preview shows each image at its relative size. The pixel size stays as before.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<60 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-content img[data-riw]').length<3;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-content img[data-riw]').length; if (n<3) throw new Error('sized images: '+n); return n; })()

caption: Reading view uses the same sizes.

after: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); return 'ok'; })()

caption: With Read Pandoc attributes on, the attribute block sizes the image and Reading view hides it.
eval: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['relative-image-width']; p.settings.pandoc=true; p.refreshAll(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview',source:false}}); for (let i=0;i<60 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view img[data-riw]').length<1;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view img[data-riw]').length; if (n<1) throw new Error('sized images: '+n); if (!document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .riw-hidden')) throw new Error('block not hidden'); return n; })()
after: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['relative-image-width']; p.settings.pandoc=false; p.refreshAll(); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the note property image-width sizes each image that has no size in its link.
eval: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['relative-image-width']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('relative-image-width-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview',source:false}}); for (let i=0;i<60 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view img[data-riw]').length<2;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view img[data-riw]').length; if (n<2) throw new Error('sized images: '+n); return n; })()
after: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['relative-image-width']; p.pro.signOut(); p.refreshAll(); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The settings: Read Pandoc attributes, and the default image size (Pro).
eval: (async () => { app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('relative-image-width'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return 'ok'; })()
